capabilities: count CJK characters in the active note
display the count in the status bar
localize the UI in English and Chinese
disambiguation: Not a general word count tool; it counts only Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters.
extras: Localization is limited to English and Chinese via a simple framework in src/i18n.js.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count includes all characters, which is unhelpful for text written mainly in CJK scripts.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses cjk-regex to filter CJK characters.

summary: Word counter that counts only Chinese, Japanese and Korean (CJK) characters and shows the count in the status bar.
